Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block

Class BarStackBE

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.BarStackBE
public class BarStackBE extends net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
One Bar Stack: 64 bars laid in eight alternating layers of eight.

A slot index is a position, not a place in a bag, and every bar must rest on the layer beneath it or on the seam with the Bar Stack below. A vertical run of these is a BarColumn, which is what automation addresses; this class owns one block's slots, its shape, and the player-facing cascade that drops whatever an extracted bar was holding up.

Capability exposure is loader-specific and lives outside this class; getItems() is what a loader-specific capability view adapts.

    • isValidBarItem

      public static boolean isValidBarItem(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack)
      Whether a Bar Stack accepts this item, the single decision point every deposit, column insertion and capability path consults. Ingot-ness is the server's ingots list resolved against the loaded item tags and named item ids, so an admin widens or narrows it without a data pack; because the Singles rule is this rule's complement, widening it narrows Singles by as much.

    • column

      @Nullable public BarColumn column()
      The column this block belongs to, or null on the client and for a block being removed.

      Resolved once a tick and held, because a machine reading this block's item handler resolves the column once per slot it walks. See StorageStackBE.pile() for the full reasoning.

    • getCachedShape

      public net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape getCachedShape()
      Returns the occupied-bar shape, rebuilding it only after contents invalidate the cache. Shape queries occur frequently enough that they must not rebuild it unconditionally.

    • depositAt

      public boolean depositAt(int index, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack fromHand)
      Puts one bar from the given stack into the named position, if that position is empty, valid, and overlapping a bar below. Refuses rather than redirecting the item elsewhere, so a caller walking positions from the bottom fills the supported ones in order.
      Returns:
      whether the bar moved; the hand shrinks by one only then

    • extractAt
